about_the_game:
Build. Defend. Extract. Survive.

Duality Drift is a unique blend of cockpit-based combat, tower defense, strategic base building and high-stakes extraction, designed from the ground up for immersive virtual reality gameplay.

Step into the cockpit and deploy to alien landscapes where crystalline resources fuel your survival. Construct your base, deploy automated defenses, and harvest as many crystals as you can. But beware: the more you collect, the stronger and smarter the resistance becomes. They don’t like to be collected.

Each deployment is a risk-reward loop - extract early with what you've gathered or push your luck and face increasingly deadly opposition. If you fall in battle, you’ll lose your collected weapons and resources for that round... but your research progress remains. Between runs, unlock powerful new weapons, buildings, and upgrades to last longer and push farther into hostile territory.

  • Cockpit Command – Direct the battlefield from your VR cockpit, issuing commands and deploying defenses in real time.

  • Strategic Base Building – Construct and expand your outpost with modular defenses, resource collectors, and support structures.

  • Resource Extraction with a twist – The more crystals you harvest, the more aggressive the enemy becomes.

  • Progression Through Failure – Even if you lose a run, you gain research points to unlock better gear for next time.

  • Evolving Arsenal – Equip and upgrade weapons, towers, and tech to adapt to new threats and extraction challenges.
